WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW   What you already know
Chapter 7 budgeted $50.00 of variable overhead a machine hour and $150,000 of fixed overhead a month. Book 2, Chapter 8 set the fixed rate using a denominator volume, and Chapter 12 of this book introduced the three-column frame.

WORKED EXAMPLE   Worked example: variable overhead in June
The variable overhead spending variance compares actual overhead with the standard rate applied to the hours worked: $71,000 − 1,460 × $50.00 = $2,000 favorable. The variable overhead efficiency variance values the extra hours at the standard rate: $1,000 unfavorable. Figure F314-04 sets out both.
